ordinaryTurns.scope: Real initial walk, wait and forced attack; input through pending output and next read. Generic C field access and pointer-table dispatch are also counted; C malloc includes this runtime's C-stack allocations. Counters are architectural acceptance, not CPU or timing samples.

productionIce.limits: Component generation on source-initialized real C/JS worlds; all map bytes, world graph and complete ordered main/display RNG logs compared. Does not identify the unavailable leaderboard recording.

timingComparison.conclusion: Effectively flat separate single runs; no demonstrated timing gain.
